sourceProfile.drawing_scope: Only split=True prior subgraph after the omitted Flow loop; excludes squeeze, flow logdet and reverse sampling.
source_contracts: -0.5 * log(2 * pi) - log_sd - 0.5 * (x - mean) ** 2 / torch.exp(2 * log_sd)

sourceFacts: Prior sees retained out, whereas density is evaluated on z_new; these operands cannot be interchanged.
log_sd denotes log standard deviation; density denominator is exp(2*log_sd), not exp(log_sd).
The three outputs are independent values; there is no z-to-retained tensor chain.
